offerings.title: Courses in the Community
offerings.blurb: Open-enrollment and congregation-based courses taught by Candler faculty across Atlanta and beyond.
offerings.description: Courses in the Community is our umbrella offering for faculty-led learning outside the seminary walls — both open-enrollment courses anyone can join and courses brought directly into congregational settings.

links.label: Bring a Course to Your Church

offerings.title: On-Demand Courses
offerings.blurb: Self-paced video courses available anytime — learn from Candler faculty on your own schedule.
offerings.description: Our on-demand library gives learners access to full Candler faculty courses at any time, with no registration window or live commitment required.

offerings.title: TheoEd
offerings.blurb: Live theological education events hosted in cities across the country, bringing Candler to local communities.
offerings.description: TheoEd is The Candler Foundry's traveling theological education event series. Each event features multiple Candler faculty talks on a shared theme, hosted in partnership with local congregations and institutions.

offerings.title: Sunday School Simplified
offerings.blurb: Ready-to-use Sunday school curriculum grounded in serious scholarship and designed for busy church leaders.
offerings.description: Sunday School Simplified provides theologically rich, practically designed curriculum that any church leader can pick up and teach — no seminary degree required.

offerings.title: 3-Minute Bible
offerings.blurb: Short-form video series making biblical scholarship accessible — one passage, one scholar, three minutes.
offerings.description: 3-Minute Bible pairs Candler faculty with a single biblical passage for a concise, engaging video exploration. The series is freely available on YouTube and used in classrooms, small groups, and personal study.

offerings.title: Candler in Conversation
offerings.blurb: A podcast featuring Candler faculty and guests exploring theology, ministry, and the life of faith.
offerings.description: Candler in Conversation is our long-form audio series where faculty, practitioners, and public voices sit down to explore ideas at the intersection of theology and contemporary life.

offerings.title: Scholar's Blog
offerings.blurb: Accessible essays and reflections from Candler faculty on scripture, theology, and church life.
offerings.description: The Scholar's Blog is a regular publication featuring original writing from Candler faculty — accessible to general audiences and designed to spark thinking and conversation in congregational and personal contexts.
